records.literal_gloss: God no one has seen ever; only-one God, the one being into the bosom of the Father, that one has explained.

en.L: No one has ever seen God; [the] one and only God, the one being in the bosom of the Father, that one has made [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}] known.
en.B: No one has ever seen God. The one and only Son, who is {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} God and is close beside the Father, has made {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} known.
en.R: No one has ever seen God. But the one and only Son, who is {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} God and is closest to the Father, has shown us what God is like.

es.L: A Dios nadie {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} ha visto jamás; [el] unigénito Dios, el que está en el seno del Padre, ese {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} ha dado a conocer.
es.B: Nadie ha visto jamás a Dios. El Hijo único, que es {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mismo Dios y está al lado del Padre, {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} ha dado a conocer.
es.R: Nadie ha visto jamás a Dios. Pero el Hijo único, que es {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mismo Dios y está más cerca del Padre que nadie, nos ha mostrado cómo es Dios.

fr.L: Dieu, personne ne {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a jamais vu ; [l’]Unique, Dieu, celui qui est dans le sein du Père, celui-là [{{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}]a fait connaître.
fr.B: Personne n’a jamais vu Dieu. Le Fils unique, qui est {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} Dieu et qui vit dans l’intimité du Père, {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a fait connaître.
fr.R: Personne n’a jamais vu Dieu. Mais le Fils unique, qui est {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} Dieu et qui est le plus proche du Père, nous a montré à quoi Dieu ressemble.

ko.L: 하나님을 아무도 본 적이 없다. 아버지의 품 안에 계신 유일하신 하나님, 그분이 [하나님을] 알려 주셨다.

pt.R: Ninguém jamais viu a Deus. Mas o Filho único, que é {{deity_pronoun:ele mesmo|Ele mesmo}} Deus e é o mais próximo do Pai, nos mostrou como Deus é.

am.L: እግዚአብሔርን ማንም ከቶ አላየውም፤ በአብ እቅፍ ያለው አንድያው አምላክ፣ እርሱ ገልጦታል።
am.B: እግዚአብሔርን ያየ ማንም የለም። ራሱ አምላክ የሆነውና በአብ አጠገብ ያለው አንድያው ልጅ ግን ገልጦታል።
am.R: እግዚአብሔርን ያየ ማንም የለም። ነገር ግን ራሱ አምላክ የሆነውና ለአብ እጅግ ቅርብ የሆነው አንድያው ልጅ እግዚአብሔር ምን እንደሚመስል አሳይቶናል።

hi.L: परमेश्वर को किसी ने कभी नहीं देखा; एकलौता परमेश्वर, जो पिता की गोद में हैं, उन्हीं ने [उन्हें] प्रकट किया।
hi.B: परमेश्वर को किसी ने कभी नहीं देखा। एकलौते पुत्र ने, जो स्वयं परमेश्वर हैं और पिता के सबसे निकट हैं, उन्हें प्रकट किया है।
hi.R: परमेश्वर को किसी ने कभी नहीं देखा। पर एकलौते पुत्र ने, जो स्वयं परमेश्वर हैं और पिता के सबसे क़रीब हैं, हमें दिखाया है कि परमेश्वर कैसे हैं।

ru.L: Бога никто не видел никогда; единственный Бог, сущий в лоне Отца, тот [{{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}] явил.
ru.B: Бога никто никогда не видел. Единственный Сын, который и сам Бог и находится рядом с Отцом, явил {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.R: Бога никто никогда не видел. Но единственный Сын, который и сам Бог и ближе всех к Отцу, показал нам, какой Бог.

uk.L: Бога ніхто ніколи не бачив; єдиний Бог, що є в лоні Отця, той [{{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}] обʼявив.
uk.B: Бога ніхто ніколи не бачив. Єдиний Син, який сам є Богом і є поруч з Отцем, обʼявив {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}.
uk.R: Бога ніхто ніколи не бачив. Але єдиний Син, який сам є Богом і найближчий до Отця, показав нам, який Бог.

ja.L: 神をかつて見た者はだれもいない。ただひとりの[子]である神、父のふところにおられる方、あの方こそが[神を]解き明かされた。
ja.B: 神を見た者は、これまでだれ一人いない。ご自身が神であり、父のすぐそばにおられるひとり子が、神を明らかに示されたのである。
ja.R: これまで神を見た人は、だれもいません。けれども、ご自身が神であり、父のいちばん近くにおられるひとり子が、神がどのような方なのかを、わたしたちに示してくださいました。

id.L: Allah tidak pernah dilihat oleh siapa pun; Allah yang tunggal, yang ada di pangkuan Bapa, {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}}lah yang telah menyatakan [{{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}}].
id.B: Tidak ada seorang pun yang pernah melihat Allah. Anak yang tunggal, yang adalah Allah sendiri dan yang paling dekat dengan Bapa, {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}}lah yang telah menyatakan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}}.
id.R: Tidak ada orang yang pernah melihat Allah. Tetapi Anak satu-satunya, yang adalah Allah sendiri dan yang paling dekat dengan Bapa, sudah menunjukkan kepada kita seperti apa Allah itu.

alternatives: the one and only Son (most later manuscripts)
decisions.reason: "God" has the oldest witnesses (the papyri P66 and P75, Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Vaticanus) and is the harder reading, which scribes were more likely to change to the familiar "Son". A footnote gives "Son".
Diners reclined so that one rested against another's chest (John 13:23). The image is intimacy.

decisions.choice: has made him known, explained him
decisions.reason: The verb, from which "exegesis" comes, means to lead out, explain, narrate. The Son reveals the God no one has seen.

decisions.choice: The one and only Son, who is himself God
decisions.reason: "The only God" would suggest the Father is not God. Supplying "Son", as in verse 14, keeps both truths.
As in verse 14.

French cannot say "one and only God" as the English Literal does: "l’unique Dieu" or "le Dieu unique" means "the only God", which would deny that the Father is God, and "engendré" brings back "begotten". The adjective is made a noun, "l’Unique", with "Dieu" in apposition, keeping the reading of the meaning decision without supplying "Fils". Balanced and Readable supply "Fils" as the English does.

decisions.choice: dans l’intimité du Père (B); le plus proche du Père (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads closeness, not location; "dans le sein" stays at Literal. "Dans l’intimité de" is the natural French for that closeness.

decisions.choice: amemtambulisha, with the object in the verb
decisions.reason: The English Literal brackets "[him]", which the Greek leaves out. Swahili puts the object inside the verb (-m-), so it cannot be bracketed or left out; "amemtambulisha" (has made him known) is the nearest Literal can come.
The meaning decision says the phrase is about closeness, not location. Literal keeps the picture of the bosom; Balanced and Readable say the closeness directly.

decisions.choice: "Đấng vốn là Đức Chúa Trời" (who is by nature God)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese says "who is himself God" most naturally with "vốn là" (is in his very being), which needs no pronoun and so no setting span.

decisions.choice: አንድያው አምላክ (the one and only God, L); ራሱ አምላክ የሆነው አንድያው ልጅ (the one and only Son, who is himself God, B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:1, "አምላክ" says what the Son is, while "እግዚአብሔር" in this verse names the God no one has seen. The SBLGNT reading "God" (meaning decision m1) is kept at every level; Balanced and Readable add "ልጅ" (Son), as the English does.
Literal keeps the image of closeness (meaning decision m2) with the familiar Hindi idiom "गोद में" (in the lap, held close); Balanced and Readable say "सबसे निकट", "सबसे क़रीब".
The meaning decision on verse 14 reads the word as unique, one of a kind. 'Единородный' is a church word that most readers no longer analyse.
The Greek verb is to explain, make known. 'Явил' says that he made God visible and known.
The English has "himself" under the setting; the style guide leaves the emphatic "сам" without a span, like the reflexive "себе".
